name: Mullion Cove harbour wall
ground: Rough/kelp-lined structure at wall; clean ground beyond the inner-arm rocks, taller rocks at high water; weedy gully at outer arm (Haddock 2007)
depth: Good depth at high water at inner arm; rocks exposed at low (Haddock 2007); wtf: 'quick access to depth'
features: Inner arm wide stone platform; outer arm high wall, only short section at end fishable; Mullion Island offshore
fishes_well_in: Light onshore breeze, clear water (wtf, C); after a big blow when fish return (Garnett, B)
fishes_badly_in: Rough weather/big swell: 'almost impossible' (Garnett); waves overtop wall (wtf, Haddock) - presentation impossible
best_tide: About 3h either side of high (Haddock 2007); rising tide or just after high (Garnett 2017)
best_light: Evening into dark: scad, pouting, conger (wtf); pollock at night close to wall on float with starlight (Haddock)
methods_baits: Float with sandeel/mackerel strip/squid; bottom bait on clean ground; LRF soft plastics/tiny baits; bread for mullet inside harbour (wtf)
size_potential: NOT FOUND (no specimen/record naming this mark found)
notes: Haddock 2007 records two deaths from waves at the wall (safety irrelevant here). Late-Nov list is inference (D) from seasons; nothing documented for November here.
